gloss: the present age; current generation; current head (of a family or school)

definitions.gloss: the present age; current era; nowadays
definitions.explanation: The current period or era, used to talk about what is happening in the present time.

definitions.gloss: current head; present master (of a family, school, or lineage)
definitions.explanation: The person who currently holds the position of head in a family line, traditional art school, or similar hereditary succession.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}{随一|ずいいち}の{名人|めいじん}だ。
examples.english: He is the foremost master of our time.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}きっての{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}と{言|い}われている。
examples.english: He is said to be the most powerful figure of the present age.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}の{若者|わかもの}はスマートフォンなしでは{生活|せいかつ}できないと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: It is said that young people of the current generation cannot live without smartphones.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}の{家元|いえもと}は{十五代目|じゅうごだいめ}だ。
examples.english: The current head of the school is the fifteenth generation.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}の{主人|しゅじん}が{店|みせ}を{継|つ}いだ。
examples.english: The current master took over the shop.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}の{当主|とうしゅ}は{先代|せんだい}の{息子|むすこ}で、{伝統|でんとう}を{大切|たいせつ}に{守|まも}っている。
examples.english: The current family head is the son of the previous head and carefully preserves the traditions.

notes:
Has two distinct uses: referring to the current era (often in literary or formal expressions praising someone as the best of their time) and referring to the person currently heading a lineage or tradition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当代|とうだい}{随一|ずいいち}: the foremost of our time
- {当代|とうだい}きっての: the best/most of our time
- {当代|とうだい}の{名人|めいじん}: master of the present age
- {当代|とうだい}の{家元|いえもと}: current head of a traditional school
- {当代|とうだい}の{当主|とうしゅ}: current family head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現代|げんだい}: modern times / the present day — the most common word for the current era
- {先代|せんだい}: previous generation / predecessor — the person who held the position before the current one
- {次代|じだい}: next generation — the upcoming successor
- {今|いま}の{時代|じだい}: the current age — everyday equivalent of {当代|とうだい} in sense 1

REGISTER:
Formal/literary. {当代|とうだい}{随一|ずいいち} and {当代|とうだい}きっての are particularly common set phrases used as high praise.
